paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page canvas, card surfaces, body text inversion, button labels. The dominant background; everything else sits on top of it

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, icon strokes, hairline borders, the logo wordmark. Used for most dividers and structural lines (border frequency 1,156)

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Secondary text and the heaviest border color in the system (freq 3,104). A warm-toned near-black that softens harsh contrast on long reads

fossil.$description: Fossil — Muted link color, inactive nav items, tertiary text. Desaturated green-gray that recedes against both paper white and ink black

slate-iris.$description: Slate Iris — Filled button background and select card surfaces — the only chromatic voice in the system. A muted violet-slate that reads as architectural blue-grey rather than brand color, so it never shouts over the photography

helveticaneue.$description: The sole typeface. Used for everything from the lowercase 'spacelab_' logo to 62px display headlines, 19–21px section headings, 17px body, and 15px captions.

helveticaneue-light.$description: Body copy and supporting paragraphs where a quieter voice is needed. The light cut creates typographic variety without changing families — a single-typeface system that breathes through weight, not variety.
